# Analysis part 1.1
- After forming the iteratively added feature models and predictions, can now visualise and investigate these further by test sites.

```{r}
df_sites <- read_csv(here("data/main/21_analysis_1.1/cleaned_sites.csv"))
df_results <- read_csv(here("data/main/21_analysis_1.1/results_1108_1217.csv"))
```

```{r}
# this pulls out the last fgeature added (splits at last comma) and then fixes for tikz
df_results_relabelled <- df_results %>%
  mutate(
    last_feature = str_extract(features, "[^,]+$"), 
    
    # does not relabel Tair with a + in front (str_detect only TRUE if a comma is in the 'features ie FALSE for Tair)
    last_feature_label = if_else(
      str_detect(features, ","),
      paste0("+ ", str_replace_all(last_feature, "_", "\\\\_")),
      str_replace_all(last_feature, "_", "\\\\_")  # no "+" for the base feature
    ),
    
    # preserves row order
    last_feature_label = factor(last_feature_label, levels = unique(last_feature_label))  
  )
```

```{r}
# colour palette
pal = ltc(trio1)


p1 <- df_results_relabelled %>%
    
    # pivot the metrics column long
    pivot_longer(cols = c(r2, rmse), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    
    # plot
    ggplot(aes(x = last_feature_label, y = value, colour = metric, group = metric)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(aes(shape = metric), size = 1) +
    
    # colour lines and rename key values
    scale_colour_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c("r2" = pal[1], "rmse" = pal[2]),
      labels = c("r2" = "R$^2$", "rmse" = "RMSE")
    ) + 
    
    # and for the geom_points
     scale_shape_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c("r2" = 5, "rmse" = 2),  # 16 = filled circle, 17 = filled triangle
        labels = c("r2" = "R$^2$", "rmse" = "RMSE")
      ) +
        
    # facet by medoid/test site
    facet_wrap(~test_site, scales = "free_y") + 
    
    # aesthetics
    theme_bw() +
    xlab("Number of features in model") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5)) 

p1
```

```{r}
# plot as TikZ object for integration into LaTeX
options(tikzLatexPackages = c(
    getOption("tikzLatexPackages"),
    "\\usepackage{MinionPro}\n",
    "\\usepackage{MnSymbol}\n"
))
tikz(here("diss/figures/1.1_p1.tex"), width = 6, height = 3, standAlone = TRUE)
print(p1)
dev.off()
```
